Choplifter III.name: Choplifter III
Choplifter III.summary: Despite sharing a similar title with the SNES game, Choplifter III is a remade version of Choplifter II: Rescue Survive and is based on the Game Gear remake of the same game, titled Choplifter III: Rescue Survive.

Go! Go! Hitchhike.name: Go! Go! Hitchhike
Go! Go! Hitchhike.summary: A board game that challenges the player to race across Europe from Athens to London by hitchhiking through 14 cities within a single year.
